description: Carbon intensity of electricity (gCO2 per kWh) for about 85 countries from Ember monthly data (CC BY 4.0): latest month and 12-month average, plus South Korea's official consumption-based factor (GIR). Use for rough household or company Scope 2 estimates; official reporting should use each country's official factor. Without country: all.

country.description: ISO code (KR, KOR), English or Korean name (Korea, 대한민국, Germany…). Omit for all.

title: Electricity carbon intensity by country (Ember)
